review_description: Customer service from initial quote thru to installation has been excellent. Our current + new panels & new hybrid inverter are producing great results- our only issue is waiting on battery availability to finalise.

Captivate owner David actually visited my home to inspect the installation site before quoting.Quote was excellent considering many of the larger firms were after a higher price for a inferior system.Arrived punctually with his team with new system installed by lunchtime after dismantelling old system.Also assisted with download and workings of the Fronius inverter  app after installation.David and his team were thoroughly professional during the whole process. No rubbish left and old system was also removed from the property.Same day after service provided in assisting with a firmware update.Overall a smooth process.
